seo.title: Getting Started — CourseCadence
seo.description: Set up CourseCadence in three steps: upload your syllabus, tell us how you study, and get your personalized plan.

sections.headline: Your personalized study plan in three simple steps
sections.lead: Setting up CourseCadence takes about 10 minutes. Have your syllabi handy and we'll handle the rest.

items.label: Step 1:
items.title: Upload your class syllabus
items.body: Upload a PDF, Word document or photo of each syllabus. CourseCadence pulls out every assignment, reading, quiz and exam date automatically.
bullets: Supports PDF, DOCX and image uploads
Review and edit anything we extract before it goes on your calendar
Add courses at any point in the term

items.label: Step 2:
items.title: Answer questions about your schedule and learning style
items.body: Tell us how you study best and what else is on your plate. A short questionnaire covers things like:
bullets: When you focus best: mornings, afternoons or late nights
How long you like to study in one sitting
Jobs, sports, clubs and other commitments to plan around

items.label: Step 3:
items.title: Get your personalized study plan
items.body: CourseCadence builds a week-by-week plan with study blocks, reading time and exam prep, and sends push notifications so nothing slips.
bullets: Plans adjust automatically when you miss a session or add a deadline
Sync with Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar
Check in daily to see exactly what's next

sections.heading: What you'll need
checklist: A syllabus for each course you're taking this term
Rough hours for work, practice or other commitments
A campus or personal email to create your account
sections.imageAlt: A student raising her hand in class

items.question: How much does CourseCadence cost?
items.answer: Every account starts with a free 30-day trial. Pricing details for after the trial will be announced soon.

items.question: Do I need a campus email to sign up?
items.answer: No. You can sign up with a campus or personal email address.

items.question: What if my syllabus changes mid-semester?
items.answer: Upload the new version or edit dates directly. Your plan rebalances automatically around the changes.

items.question: Does CourseCadence work for graduate students?
items.answer: Yes. Anyone managing coursework and deadlines can use CourseCadence, from first-year undergrads to grad students.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Yes. We only use your information to build your plan, and we never sell student data. See our Privacy Policy and Campus Data Security pages for details.

sections.heading: Start your 30-day free trial
sections.text: Get your personalized study plan in minutes.
